description.value: ABURI Market is an elevated Japanese grocery concept by the award-winning restaurant group behind Miku and Minami, offering premium imported Japanese products in a grocerant format at its Ambleside location in West Vancouver. Cyclists stopping in will find finish-at-home meal kits, ready-to-eat bento and bowls, exclusive A5 Iwate Wagyu cuts, fresh sashimi-grade fish via Hyoketsu flash-freeze technology, imported snacks, and Japanese lifestyle goods. The store is situated within the Grosvenor Ambleside development, a 2021 ULI Americas Award of Excellence winner.

address.value: 1350 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0B5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the ABURI Market Ambleside location at 1350 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, an active and open Japanese specialty grocery concept. The contact/cart pages provide a phone number (604) 926-4411 and email not present in OSM, and corroborate the address. The website mentions 'ample underground parking available' at Ambleside but makes no reference to bike-specific parking, water refill, or any other cycling amenities; the store sells premium Japanese groceries, ready-to-eat bento, wagyu, sashimi, and imported goods.
concerns: OSM tags the business as shop=convenience, which significantly undersells it — ABURI Market is a premium Japanese specialty grocerant, not a convenience store. The Groceries category is appropriate but the OSM tag may mislead.
Phone number (604) 926-4411 was not present in the OSM record; sourced from the website's contact and cart pages.
Website mentions 'ample underground parking available' at Ambleside but this refers to vehicle parking only — no bike parking information found.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialty Japanese grocery with an active website confirming the West Vancouver Ambleside location is operating.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists three locations: Ambleside (West Vancouver, this OSM record), Downtown (609 Granville St, Vancouver), and Yaletown (1112 Mainland St, Vancouver). The other two locations may warrant separate OSM/directory records.
